message.content: Good morning. I have a shift starting in three hours and my brain is still asleep. Can you help me draft a quick email to the school? I need to confirm I’ll be at the PTA meeting for Inès, but I also need to know if the venue is still Lycée Ampère or if they moved it again.

content.text: Good morning, Claire. It is indeed March 12th, a Thursday. The PTA meeting for Lycée Ampère is scheduled for next Tuesday, March 17th, at 6:30 PM. message.content: Yes, please. Keep it short. Just say I’ll be there. Also, can you check if Madame Girard has posted any updates about Inès's ballet recital? I feel like I keep missing those messages because I’m always on call.

content.text:
I’ve drafted the email. It reads: 'Dear Principal, I am writing to confirm my attendance at the PTA meeting on Tuesday, March 17th, at 6:30 PM. I look forward to discussing the upcoming events. Best regards, Claire Morel.'

Regarding Madame Girard, there are no new messages from her as of this morning. The last update was on March 5th regarding costume fittings. Shall I set a reminder for you to check in with her this evening?

content.text: For the 2025 tax year, the childcare expense credit in France allows you to claim 50% of eligible expenses up to a maximum of €15,000 per child. Since Hugo turned 5 last month, he remains eligible until he starts primary school full-time, depending on your specific enrollment status. Do you have the final invoices from his daycare for the current quarter yet?

message.content: I don’t think so. I’ll ask Julien to send them to me later. He handles most of the admin stuff anyway. Thanks. I need to go shower. Wake me up in 45 minutes so I can eat something.
